name: A Small Southeastern Hospital Had Effective Cybersecurity Controls To Prevent, Detect, and Respond To Cyberattacks
known_limitations: The audited hospital is anonymous, testing covered four selected public-facing websites in June 2025, and OIG states that testing may not have disclosed every deficiency. The result cannot be generalized to HHS, CMS, other hospitals, or later periods. Phase 56M preserves audit identity, tested period, finding, recommendation state, and reopening rule.
source_owner: Department of Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General
notes: Phase 56M federal remediation and outcome continuation source. Collection: federal-remediation-outcomes-batch-one-2026.
